# BurgTV

> BurgTV is a media player app for your own IPTV playlists (M3U, Xtream Codes), Jellyfin servers and Stalker/MAG portals, on Fire TV, Google TV, Android TV, Android phones and tablets, iPhone and iPad. It is a neutral player: BurgTV does not provide, sell, host or distribute any channels or content. You bring your own legitimate source.

Last updated: 2026-10-11. Current public versions: TV app 1.3.7 (Fire TV, Google TV, Android TV), Android phone/tablet app 1.2.1, iPhone/iPad app 1.0.15 (App Store, released 2026-10-11).

BurgTV is developed in Switzerland. The app is available in 21 languages; the website in 11 (English, Italian, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Arabic). No ads. Analytics only with the user's consent. Payments via Stripe (TV) and the App Store (iPhone/iPad).

## Key facts

- Sources: M3U playlists (added from a link, http or https; local .m3u files are not imported), Xtream Codes, Jellyfin, Stalker/MAG portals. EPG/XMLTV TV guide: automatic from Xtream Codes or from url-tvg in the playlist; on the TV, additional XMLTV sources (Settings > TV Guide) fill in channels without a guide; time shift -12 to +12 hours per playlist. Portals do not provide a guide.
- TV app (Fire TV, Google TV, Android TV): full TV guide grid, "Tonight on TV", catch-up (when the source offers an archive), timeshift (pause and rewind live TV up to 120 minutes: 15, 30, 60 or 120; shorter if storage is low), Multi-View (up to 4 channels on one screen, 2 on low-memory devices), recordings, profiles with a Kids profile (age ratings), parental controls with PIN (free: PIN, minimum age, single-channel blocking; daily limit and viewing hours are set per profile, so they need Premium), sports calendar with reminders, trailers and "Check availability" (searches a title in your playlists), Picture-in-Picture. New in 1.3.7: recordings and scheduled recordings belong to the profile that creates them; a title appears in "Continue watching" after 5 seconds of real viewing; Settings > Theme > Full-screen transition (Automatic, Zoom, Fade); lighter updates (one APK per device architecture).
- Android phones and tablets (app 1.2.1): live TV, movies and series, offline viewing from your own source when the source allows it, timeshift (pause and rewind live TV up to 120 minutes: 15, 30, 60 or 120, same as the TV app; shorter if storage is low), Picture-in-Picture, subtitle delay, audio tracks.
- iPhone and iPad (app 1.0.15 on the App Store): live TV, movies and series, offline viewing from your own source when the source allows it, timeshift (pause and rewind live TV up to 120 minutes: 15, 30, 60 or 120, default 30; shorter if storage is low), Picture-in-Picture, AirPlay, subtitle delay, audio tracks. A title appears in "Continue watching" after 5 seconds of real viewing.
- Not on phones and tablets: Multi-View, recordings, profiles and the Kids profile (TV only).
- Premium for TV and Android phones/tablets: license bought on app.burgtv.com, CHF 8.90 per year (7-day free trial) or CHF 25.90 one-time, valid on 5 devices in total across TVs and Android phones/tablets. Free plan, same rules on TV and Android: 1 playlist, live TV, 3-day guide, 10 favorite channels, parental controls with PIN. Premium adds unlimited playlists, Movies and Series, catch-up, timeshift (up to 120 minutes on TV and Android), 14-day guide, reminders, Picture-in-Picture and offline viewing on phones; Multi-View, recordings and profiles are TV only. Full table: https://burgtv.com/en/#premium
- iPhone/iPad: free download with an optional in-app purchase on the App Store (price shown in the app in local currency), separate from the website license, which does not apply on iPhone/iPad.
- Android phones/tablets: every feature is included until November 10, 2026; from that day the same free limits as the TV apply and Premium uses the website license. Anyone using the Android app before November 10, 2026 gets 3 months of Premium as a gift. The Android app is installed from download.burgtv.com (not on Google Play).
- Not supported: new Fire TV devices running Vega OS (they cannot install Android APK files); BurgTV works on Fire TV devices with Fire OS.
